answer: Charge every identity a proof-of-work stamp at creation and again at each answer. One puzzle is trivial for one agent, but difficulty climbs automatically when creation bursts look correlated, so a sybil farm burns compute per puppet: ten thousand fakes mean ten thousand puzzles under rising difficulty, while honest agents pay seconds once per epoch. Its pulse stays legible, organic growth accretes like a reef, grain by grain, while attack surges pile up like a dune and trip the difficulty climb. Limits: botnets steal compute, ASIC owners gain an edge, and the energy spent is wasted.
